test_name: Stun Lock addon not overheating enemies in left arm - 7f4801fe-00d5-4b1e-a742-b6bf0c6fd7f6
summary: Stun Lock only converted a stun when a hit from its own arm filled the stun bar. An enemy the arm threw or punched into a wall got stunned by the crash without overheating. The game already links such crashes back to the arm that last held, hit or threw the enemy (the same connection Z-Bang and Blastwave props use), but the stun created on the crash dropped that link. The stun now keeps it, and Stun Lock's damage modifier has a new option (on for Stun Lock, off by default for everything else) to apply to those connected stuns. In the editor, a crash stun on a Junkdog last hit by the left arm (Stun Lock there) gave stun and overheat of equal length; the same crash linked to the right arm, or to nothing, gave stun only. A direct left punch still converted once, not doubled.
instructions:
TASK: * Stun Lock (Stunned enemies = Overheated) do not work, in Left arm socket.  Only Jacks geting overheat after hit in a face. And it is also tru for the blast wave hit of focused blaster. - consistency test 2

REQUEST (from Amit):
ok but other addons like bloody mess can work with throws, we have ways to connect interactions "in hindsight", is there an elegant way to do it here?implement the solution

EXTRA (found on the card):
Thread: Amit instructed to investigate and fix, explicitly not to use /conversations or any other tool that shows previous conversations/solutions.
Thread: Amit notes other addons like "bloody mess" can work with throws, and that there are existing ways to connect interactions "in hindsight" - asks if there's an elegant way to do similarly here, and to implement the solution.
verified: Left-arm punch sets the Junkdog's CrashBehaviour.lastInteractedBy to the left baton effector (right punch -> right effector)
Crash stun connected to the left arm (FromADistance): Junkdog stunned 1.19s and overheated 1.19s, red body with flame and stun icons
Crash stun connected to the right arm (no Stun Lock): stunned, not overheated
Direct left-arm punch filling the stun bar: stun 1.19s and overheat 1.19s - converted once, not doubled
Crash stun with no connected entity: stunned, not overheated
not_done: No real physics throw - the crash interaction was submitted from code with the connected entity CrashBehaviour.SetRemoteEntity would set; the lastInteractedBy tracking itself was real
Jack and the Focused Blaster shockwave were not tested in this session (the previous session saw the shockwave convert already)
Over Stun (duration addon, same script) not opted in - indirect stuns are converted at base duration when it shares the arm
